content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have several [product_name] devices with [version_no] version 1.82.01. I am able to send programs over the internet using [product_name], but I am encountering an issue with [product_name] projects. The software does not allow me to transfer the project to a device on a different network. I am looking for advice on how to address this issue, as it doesn't seem to be related to security if controller access is already possible. Regards
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. You should consider submitting a support request.

Since the outcome of [product_name] can only be stored on a Micro-SD card and not directly in the [product_name] device, you can typically transfer the project only within the local area network (LAN, 10/100 Mbit/s). Once the web server is set up, it can be remotely accessed via a web browser using TCP port 8080.

analysis.insight_summary: The user has identified a restriction in [product_name], which prevents transferring projects to devices outside the local network. Although remote access to the controller itself is possible, deployment of web projects is limited to the same local network, causing confusion regarding the system’s remote programming capabilities and limiting flexible workflows.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to have the ability to send [product_name] projects over the internet to devices outside the local network, similar to how controller programs can be sent remotely.
